owner: Hanwha Solution (project SPC, Muwa Jade) with Hanwha E&C construction division as builder
notes: Newspim (2026-05-20) reports Hanwha's construction division is building the Hanwha Solution Anseong data center, an around KRW 80-81.5 billion construction project (Hanwha E&C listed the Anseong data center among its data center works at 81.5 billion won construction cost); Hanwha e-Pyeonhanse world history pages reference an 'Anseong data center' special purpose company (Muwa Jade). In construction as of mid-2026; no public MW figure found.
